authors.name: Akil Mahmod Tipu
authors.bio: I work with AWS infrastructure, delivery pipelines and operational automation. My experience spans ECS and Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, observability and mentoring engineers. In this course, I connect each command to the decision behind it—and the evidence that tells us it worked.
authors.teachingNote: We will predict a change, inspect the result, explain a failure and recover deliberately. The aim is to help you make sound engineering decisions when the example changes.

title: Infrastructure Automation with Terraform
subtitle: Build, protect, refactor and deliver one project with Terraform and Ansible
description: Comprehensive hands-on course covering Terraform fundamentals, HCL syntax, AWS infrastructure provisioning, state management, module creation, and enterprise CI/CD automation.

project.name: CourseOps
project.description: Build a service-status website across eight milestones, with guided labs and an independent assignment after every section.
paths: Cloud-free practice or an AWS sandbox

heroTitle: From your first plan to a reviewed release.
heroDescription: Build CourseOps, a small status-page service, while learning to provision, test, recover and configure infrastructure. One project. Eight milestones. Evidence at every step.

days.name: Day 1
days.title: Understand & deploy
days.outcome: Explain the architecture and make your first verified change.

days.name: Day 2
days.title: Protect & recover
days.outcome: Recover a partial apply and prove environment separation.

days.name: Day 3
days.title: Reuse & refactor
days.outcome: Test a module contract and preserve resource identities.

days.name: Day 4
days.title: Configure & review
days.outcome: Render the service, verify repeatability and review a release.
